Name: Zevlor Replaces Elliott
Author: cakeboxie
Description:
What it says on the tin! I modified Elliott's sprites to be Zevlor from BG3 bc I love this sad old tiefling an unreasonable amount :D

Currently only his sprites are included! I do plan on adding the portraits, but for now i have other things to be working on that take priority!

Downloads.Description: Includes warm weather, winter, and beach sprites!
